an3.142:1.1: Tayo ca bhikkhave bhadde assājānīye desessāmi tayo ca bhadde purisājānīye.
an3.142:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissamī ti.
an3.142:2.1: Katame ca bhikkhave tayo bhaddā assājānīyā?
an3.142:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo . . . pe . . .
an3.142:2.3: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.142:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo bhaddā assājānīyā.
an3.142:3.1: Katame ca bhikkhave tayo bhaddā purisājānīyā?
an3.142:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco bhaddo purisājānīyo . . . pe . . .
an3.142:3.3: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca. 2.
an3.142:4.2: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
an3.142:4.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.142:4.5: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti no saṃsādeti.
an3.142:4.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhaddo purisājānīyo javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.142:4.10: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo bhaddā purisājānīyā
